thread:
sarah_support: Customer reported repeated 429s from Dedicated pool B after a normal traffic spike. They saw throttling and retries, billing alerts fired.

raj_oncall: Looking at logs for org-123. Most requests are hitting `route_decision=default-pool` even though tenant header maps to dedicated-pool-b. Suspect header parsing weirdness.

ben_infra: Quick sample from gateway: `X-Tenant: org-123, org-123` — two headers got concatenated with a comma by the edge. Control plane then ran selector regex and failed to match, fellthrough to default route.

mike_eng: Repro in my laptop: `curl -H 'X-Tenant: org-123' -H 'X-Tenant: org-123' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -v` -> routed to default pool and returned 429 when default was busy. Logs: `selector=tenant_id:null` when duplicate present.

anna_prod: Autoscaler telemetry didn't trigger because the controlplane's misroute removes tenant label before metrics export. So dedicated pool didn't scale and noisy neighbor on default got throttled.

sarah_support: Customer impact: increased latency + retries, some billing spikes due to retries. They asked for a root cause and mitigation.

raj_oncall: Temporary mitigations applied: 1) ingress rule to coerce duplicate X-Tenant to single header for org-123, 2) manual +2 node scale for dedicated-pool-b, 3) set rate-limit override for default pool to protect other tenants. Monitoring enabled.

ben_infra: Found likely regression: flag `mergeDuplicateHeaders=true` toggled in controlplane deploy on 2025-11-03. It concatenates duplicates with "," which breaks our routing selector grammar that expects a bare tenant id.

mike_eng: Submitted fix PR 3124 to change parser to prefer the last header value and trim commas/whitespace, plus unit tests for multi-header cases and header-order invariants. Planning canary tonight.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: controlplane v1.4.7-canary -> cluster=canary, rollout=50%. Logs: https://deploys/redwood/3124-canary

anna_prod: After ingress coercion + manual scale we see 429s drop by ~90% and latency for org-123 back to normal. Autoscaler rule will be corrected once parser fix lands. :thumbsup:

sarah_support: Notified customer and offered one week credit for retry-related costs. Will follow up tomorrow to confirm closure.

mike_eng: Follow-up: adding additional e2e test in infra/e2e to send duplicate headers and assert routing selection. Also adding a metric `controlplane.duplicate_header_count` to surface this earlier.
notes: thread contains logs, repro curl, mitigation actions, PR and deploy references
